Module info5.sar
Package info5.sar.EventBasedChannel.Impl

Class Channel

java.lang.Object
info5.sar.EventBasedChannel.Impl.Channel
All Implemented Interfaces:
IChannel
public class Channel extends Object implements IChannel
The Channel class implements the IChannel interface and provides methods for reading and writing data through a circular buffer. It supports setting a listener for handling read and write events, and managing the connection state.

Fields:

  • _rch - The remote channel for communication.
  • _disconnected - A flag indicating if the channel is disconnected.
  • _dangling - A flag indicating if the channel is in a dangling state.
  • _in - The circular buffer for incoming data.
  • _out - The circular buffer for outgoing data.
  • _listener - The listener for the channel.
  • _writeBuffer - A queue for storing data to be written.
  • _readBuffer - A queue for storing data to be read.

Methods:

  • setListener(IChannelListener) - Sets the listener for the channel.
  • getListener() - Gets the listener for the channel.
  • read(byte[]) - Reads data from the channel.
  • write(byte[]) - Writes data to the channel.
  • disconnect() - Disconnects the channel.
  • disconnected() - Checks if the channel is disconnected.
